segments.comment: A debug Valkyrie level-teleports to D:2, whose shop is an irregular themed room with a locked door at its north-west corner. shknam.c stock_room() asks shk.c inside_shop() which side of the door the shop lies on; the walls inside the room's bounding box are not part of the shop, so the 'Closed for inventory' engraving goes on the corridor east of the door. ^F maps the level and draws it with the corridor engraving symbol.

comment: shknam.c stock_room(): the 'Closed for inventory' square outside a locked door of an irregular shop. The seed, found by searching for such a shop, the clock, character and inputs were chosen for this case.
